title: Inglorious
summary: INGLO'RIOUS, adjective [Latin inglorius; in and gloria.] 1. Not glorious; not bringing honor or glory; not accompanied with fame or celebrity; as an inglorious life of ease. 2. Shameful; disgraceful.

inlines.v: INGLO'RIOUS, adjective [Latin inglorius; in and gloria.] 1. Not glorious; not bringing honor or glory; not accompanied with fame or celebrity; as an inglorious life of ease. 2. Shameful; disgraceful. He charged his troops with inglorious flight.
